common.appTitle: Carbon Neutrality Spatiotemporal Big Data Platform

welcome: Welcome to the Carbon Neutrality Spatiotemporal Big Data Platform!
We hope our system provides you with convenient services and helps you better observe carbon neutrality conditions around the planet!
aboutContent: This platform integrates multi-source heterogeneous carbon neutrality spatiotemporal big data with a structured data partitioning scheme. It employs tiered big data classification and storage technologies to build a hybrid storage architecture for data organization and management. PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, HDFS, and HBase are respectively used to store relational data, real-time dynamic data, log data, map cache data, text data, massive imagery data, and large-scale vector data. Convolutional neural networks, OCR text extraction, natural language processing models, and Geo-ETL components are adopted for object information extraction. Based on semantic segmentation and spatiotemporal association fusion algorithms, an intelligent carbon neutrality information extraction and association fusion model is created, building a carbon neutrality domain knowledge graph. The foundation framework is built on Hadoop, integrating asymmetric encryption algorithms, data obfuscation, federated learning, and other security frameworks. Following data warehouse theory, data is stored according to different usage characteristics, supported by the latest virtualized computing infrastructure and distributed computing architecture to enable high-performance retrieval and analysis of carbon neutrality big data.

login.platformDescription: The Report of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China proposed actively and steadily promoting carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals, viewing these dual-carbon objectives as an important component of ecological civilization. Carbon neutrality means achieving net-zero carbon dioxide emissions from human activities by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and increasing carbon absorption. Achieving carbon neutrality is of great significance in addressing climate change, protecting the ecological environment, and realizing sustainable development.
